description: Golden Thoughts is a permanent art installation on the Tagliamento River (Udine, Italy).
Two 50-meter-high pylons, rising from the Tagliamento Riverbed, are painted gold. Their geometric shape frames the surrounding landscape.

The Tagliamento is considered the only river in the Alpine region, and one of the few in Europe, to retain its original braided-channel morphology, where the water changes its course throughout the year, not being constrained by a single, embanked riverbed.
title: Golden
Thoughts

description: Mulberry trees are an iconic symbol of Friulian landscape and history. Still nowadays you can find them all around the countryside, beside one field and another. They evokes social and economic aspects during the 19th and early 20th century, and the ancient and ancestral wisdoms of the Benandanti, which general beliefs tell were members of a pagan-shamanic peasant cult based on the fertility of the land.
